records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Rafael,

Your workspace for Bright Dynamics is ready to go. The single highest-leverage thing in week one is creating a real project rather than a test one -- it's what makes the first week actually useful.

I'm here if anything's unclear.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: First project created day 0 (2026-06-18) but no activity since; no invite sent, no key milestone, no replies to onboarding email [email:3409ebbb], no tickets. Six quiet days on Starter with 8 left suggests modest odds of unaided activation.

draft.subject: A quick next step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Rafael,

Nice work getting your first project set up last week. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so adding the real work into that project is usually what makes the first couple of weeks click.

If it's useful, I'm happy to jump on a short call this week to look at how your team's work maps into projects and tasks, and answer anything that's come up so far.

Best,
Priya
